page_title: RealtyGenius.AI - Your AI-Powered Real Estate Assistant

sources.entry: RealtyGenius - Offers efficient document management and collaboration functionalities for real estate professionals. #freemium

summary.name: RealtyGenius.AI
summary.one_liner: An AI assistant for real estate professionals that stores and organizes documents, lets users chat with them, and supports team collaboration.
keywords: knowledge base for real estate teams
use_cases: organizing real estate documents in one place
sharing documents with a real estate team
answering internal questions from stored files
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool for uploading and organizing real estate documents in one place. Users can chat with their documents, with the AI described as trained on all documents in the organization. The page says the assistant can answer questions drawn from those files. It also lists features for sharing documents with team members and accessing them from anywhere. Documents are described as encrypted at rest and in transit. The page gives no detail on file types, integrations, or how answers are generated.
notable: Chat with uploaded real estate documents via an AI assistant
End-to-end encryption for documents at rest and in transit
Listed as freemium in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
caveats: Pricing tiers and free-plan limits are not stated on the page; freemium status comes from the directory listing
Page claims 200+ companies use it and a 4.8/5 TrustPilot rating, which are unverified marketing claims
